The return flight over the lake landscape of the Upper Engadine completes your flying experience.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernina-standard-helicopter-scenic-flight-from-samedan/)

With this seat reservation, you travel on the Bernina Express panoramic train between Chur and Tirano in Italy. \\
OfferLuganoNovember 18, 2026\\

Book your seat on the Bernina Express Bus and enjoy a relaxing journey through the Alps. Secure your preferred seat with panoramic views.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernina-express-bus-reservation-from-lugano-or-tirano/)
- [**Bernina Express tickets and seat reservations**\\
\\
OfferSt. MoritzNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
Book the Bernina Express in one step: train ticket with seat reservation, just the train ticket or only the reservation. Between Chur or St. Moritz and Tirano, one-way or round trip on the same day.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernina-express-tickets-and-seat-reservations/)

Take the Bernina Express Bus through the Alps from Lugano to Tirano or vice versa. Enjoy a varied journey with impressive landscapes and charming villages along the route.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernina-express-bus-ticket-from-lugano-or-tirano/)

Route](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/bernina-tour-53_02/)

Breathtaking landscapes, a unique glacier world and dreamlike lake landscapes in the heart of the Engadine.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/bernina-ultraks/)
- [**Bernina Bergell Scenic Flight from Samedan**\\
\\
OfferSamedanNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
With the Bernina-Bregaglia helicopter tour, you’ll discover the glacier world of the Bernina Massif and the Val Bregaglia. The return flight over the lakes of Upper Engadin, with views of striking peaks, crowns your flying experience.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernina-bergell-scenic-flight-from-samedan/)
- [**Bernina-Tour**\\
\\
RoutePoschiavo](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/bernina-tour/)
- [**Bernina Express**\\
\\
RouteSamedan\\
\\
On the Bernina Express you travel from the glaciers of the Engadine to an ice cream cone at the Mediterranean piazza of Poschiavo with many trail highlights in between. They make this tour one of the most beautiful in Switzerland. A classic!](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/bernina-express/)
- [**Bernina Express Pullman Class**\\
\\
OfferSt. MoritzMay 31, 2027\\
\\
The Pullman Class is the new travel class on the Bernina Express. The journey in a nostalgic carriage styled after the 1930s combines historic travel culture with personal service and selected cuisine into a harmonious overall experience. The highlight is a visit to the La Gatta winery, where you can enjoy a local lunch paired with matching wines. In the Pullman Class, crossing the Alps on the world-famous UNESCO World Heritage route between high mountains and the Southern Alps becomes an experience that will stay with you for a long time.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernina-express-pullman-class/)
- [**Bernina Herb Express**\\
\\
ExperienceChur\\
\\
A journey on the Bernina Herb Express to Le Prese is a chance for passengers to experience the UNESCO World Heritage Site up close and immerse themselves in the world of herbs in Valposchiavo.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/bernina-herb-express/)
- [**Bernina Express panoramic train seat reservation from St. Moritz or Tirano**\\
\\
OfferSt. MoritzNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
With this seat reservation, you travel on the Bernina Express panoramic train between St. Moritz and Tirano in Italy. You will enjoy the unique view through the extra-large panoramic windows.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernina-express-panoramic-train-seat-reservation-from-st-moritz-or-tirano/)
- [**Piz Bernina (4,049m a.s.l.)**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
This is the highest peak in the canton of Graubünden. Piz Bernina stands out due to its almost freestanding nature and as a result also offers unique far-reaching views from its summit.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/piz-bernina-4049m-asl/)
